messages:
Maria Chen: Just got a weird email from accounts@redwood-invoices.com with subject 'Past Due Notice' and attachment statement.docm. I only previewed in Gmail web UI, didn't open or download.
PhishSandboxBot: Submission received (id: 1758125678). Attachment queued for sandbox detonation.
PhishSandboxBot: Sandbox detonation complete. Findings: embedded VBA macro in statement.docm that attempts to download hxxp://bad.example/payload.exe using bitsadmin. Simulated execution spawned downloader, attempted C2 beacons to 192.0.2.10 and 192.0.2.11. No credential harvesting observed in simulation window.
OnCall-SOC: Good catch @Maria. Immediate steps: 1) block sender domain at gateway 2) add URLs and IPs to firewall denylist 3) create incident ticket and attach sandbox report 4) kick off EDR scans for recipients.
PhishSandboxBot: Created ticket INC-2026-046 and attached the sandbox report and IOCs (url:hxxp://bad.example/payload.exe, md5: e99a18c428cb38d5f260853678922e03).
Jonathan Klein: Running SIEM search now: `index=mail sourcetype=gmail (subject="Past Due Notice" OR sender="accounts@redwood-invoices.com") | stats count by recipient`
Jonathan Klein: Found 3 hits to 3 distinct internal recipients over ~6 hours. Only Maria had an attachment; others received link-only variants.
Samir Patel: @Maria can you confirm you didn't click "Open in external app" or enable macros? Also please don't reboot until I check the agent logs.
Maria Chen: Confirm I did not open externally and did not enable macros. No reboots.
Samir Patel: Running remote EDR sweep on Maria and the other two recipients for process creation and suspicious persistence artifacts. Will isolate if I see active downloaders.
Alex Reyes: I'll check email auth. DMARC/SPF/DKIM lookups incoming.
Alex Reyes: SPF: fail for accounts@redwood-invoices.com (mail came from 198.51.100.45 not in SPF). DKIM: header not present. DMARC: p=none. Looks spoofed.
Infra Team: Blocking hxxp://bad.example and IPs 192.0.2.10, 192.0.2.11 at perimeter and adding domain to gateway denylist.
Samir Patel: EDR results: Maria: clean (no downloader present, no persistence). Other two recipients: no malicious artifacts. No isolation required.
Lisa Monroe: Drafted a short awareness blurb: "Security FYI: We flagged a phishing email impersonating billing with an attachment named statement.docm. Do not enable macros or open unexpected attachments. If you receive a suspicious message, report it via the phishing button or #eng-security." Want me to send this now?
OnCall-SOC: Hold until we've scanned the final mailbox and attached the SIEM results. Also include the three IOCs and a screenshot of the email headers showing SPF fail.
Jonathan Klein: SIEM timeline looks clean after the initial delivery window; no lateral auth anomalies in the last 12 hours.
PhishSandboxBot: Monitoring ticket INC-2026-046 for 24h. Will post if sandbox or SIEM detects additional activity.
OnCall-SOC: Action owner summary: Alex (auth headers & IOCs), Infra (network blocks), Samir (EDR sweep), Lisa (awareness draft), Jonathan (SIEM search). Marking INC-2026-046 as triage-complete. Schedule 20-min post-incident sync tomorrow at 11:00 to confirm closure.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone for the quick response. Glad I reported it. :thumbsup:
